function.name: get_current_shopping_list
function.description: Returns the current active shopping list with all items for the household.

function.name: add_items_to_list
function.description: Adds one or more items to the current shopping list. Use this when the user wants to add products.

unit.description: Unit like ks, g, ml, balenie (optional)

function.name: remove_item_from_list
function.description: Removes one item from the current shopping list by its ID.

function.name: update_item_in_list
function.description: Updates an existing item (change quantity, notes, etc.).

function.name: archive_current_list
function.description: Archives the current shopping list and creates a fresh empty one. Use only after user confirmation in most cases.

ordered_from.description: Which store the list was ordered from (optional)

notes.description: Optional note about this archive (e.g. 'Večera s krevetami')

function.name: get_recent_archived_lists
function.description: Returns the most recent archived shopping lists (history).
